820770 (end mills, ball nose, T-slot cutters, form tools, thread mills, engraving/grooving tools)

product_summary: Orient Tools (Pune, Maharashtra; Plot No. 21, S Block, MIDC Bhosari; est. 2011; ISO 9001/14001/45001; 5-axis CNC grinding) manufactures solid carbide, brazed carbide and lugged carbide cutting tools. Product lines listed on orienttools.co.in: Solid Carbide Ball Nose, Burnishing Tool, Center Drill, Drill, End Mills, Engrooving Tools, Form Tools, T-Slot Cutters, Reamers, Special Tools, Step Drills, Thread Mills. Serves automobile, aerospace, medical, energy, 3C, general engineering, defence. Contact: deepak@orienttools.co.in, +91 9145414243. Source: https://www.orienttools.co.in/ (homepage, product taxonomy and About Us).
comment: Declared codes 820740/820750/820760/820770 are largely consistent with the actual catalogue: 820750 covers drills (solid carbide drill, step drill, center drill), 820770 covers milling tools (end mills, ball nose, T-slot cutters, form tools, thread mills, grooving/engraving), 820760 covers reamers. Status: partial, not exact. (1) 820740 (taps/dies for threading) is NOT corroborated - the site lists Thread Mills, which are milling cutters under 820770, not taps; no tap/die line found. (2) Burnishing tools and 'Special Tools' are not covered by the declared four codes - burnishing is a surface-finishing tool, likely 820790 (other interchangeable tools) or possibly 8460/8467 machine-tool classification; needs confirmation. (3) Brazed and lugged carbide tools are declared in the About Us text but no separate HS line exists in the declaration for brazed turning/threading inserts (820780) - product line missing from declaration if sold as inserts. (4) Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is a misclassification: the company is a metal-cutting tool (machine tool accessories) manufacturer serving automotive/aerospace/medical/energy/defence, not a metallurgy or mining supplier. Correct industry: machine tools / cutting tools manufacturing. (5) No trader signs - own plant, own CNC grinding, own brand, ISO certifications, so manufacturer role is well supported. (6) All product data is from the company's own website; no customs line was available to this researcher, therefore the entire product range is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level. Per project rule 3, the HS discrepancy is not a rejection ground - company retained, code set corrected to 820750/820760/820770/820790 with 820740 flagged as unconfirmed.
